phoneNumbers.description: List of phone numbers that need to be added.

numberType.description: The type of the number. Required for `MOBILE` number type.

numberUsageType.description: The type of usage expected for the number.

state.description: The state of the number. By default, the state of a number is set to `ACTIVE` for DID and toll-free numbers only. Mobile numbers will be activated upon assignment to a user.

subscriptionId.description: The `subscriptionId` to be used for the mobile number order.

carrierId.description: The `carrierId` to be used for the mobile number order.
